user_query: trass gmail about australia international registration and launch

intent.goal: find emails in Trass Gmail about Australia international registration and launch

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace, 
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.subject,
g.sender_name,
g.sender_email,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content,
g.email_date
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND (
    LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%australia%' 
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%australia%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%australia%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%international%' 
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%registration%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%registration%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%registration%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%launch%'
)
ORDER BY g.email_date DESC
LIMIT 1200;

We need to generate the WRO and pallet labels now so we can apply them before transferring the pallets to temporary storage. This would allow us to keep our logistics moving while the tax registration finalizes. Thanks for your help on this. Best, Koii Koii Benvenutto PM Plush and Merch koii@trassgames.com
